angle: Non-porous stainless steel surface prevents raw meat juice absorption for clean, hygienic meal prep.
hook: A chef cutting raw meat on a porous wooden board that absorbs juices, followed by clean prep on a silver steel board.
opening_visual: A chef cuts raw chicken on a cracked wooden board that absorbs juices, looking concerned.
prompt_text:
Create one 10-second vertical 9:16 realistic video of a male chef cooking in a clean kitchen with dark slate countertops. From 0.0 to 5.0 seconds, a high-angle handheld shot shows his worried expression as he cuts raw chicken on a cracked wooden board that visibly absorbs the juices. From 5.0 to 10.0 seconds, the camera shifts to a medium handheld shot showing the same chef smiling and slicing vibrant red bell peppers on a sleek, rigid silver stainless steel chopping board with a downward-folded lip that securely grips the edge of the dark slate counter. Natural ambient lighting. No dialogue, no lip-sync, no subtitles, no text overlays, no UI, no watermark.
Create one 10-second vertical 9:16 realistic close-up video of a stainless steel cutting board. From 0.0 to 3.5 seconds, show a close-up shot of a hand using a knife to slice clean pieces of raw chicken breast on the flat, smooth silver metal surface. From 3.5 to 7.0 seconds, show the board being rinsed under running tap water, with all meat juices washing off instantly leaving a clean, spotless surface. From 7.0 to 10.0 seconds, show a stable close-up hero shot of the board resting on the counter, showcasing the front edge with its 1cm downward-folded lip hooked over the countertop edge. No dialogue, no subtitles, no text overlays, no UI, no watermark.
